Interface KfeChannelOperationDecisionRepository

All Superinterfaces:

@Repository public interface KfeChannelOperationDecisionRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeChannelOperationDecisionEntity,UUID>
Reads channel-operation decisions for idempotent requests, recovery, and administrative history.

    • findResumableOpens

      @Query("select e from KfeChannelOperationDecisionEntity e\nwhere e.operation = :op\n and e.passed = true\n and e.executed = false\n and lower(e.peerPubkey) = lower(:peer)\n and e.amountSats = :amount\n and e.meshInjectPhase in :phases\norder by e.createdAt desc\n") List<KfeChannelOperationDecisionEntity> findResumableOpens(@Param("op") KfeChannelOperationType op, @Param("peer") String peer, @Param("amount") Long amount, @Param("phases") List<String> phases, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Finds approved, unexecuted channel-open decisions eligible to resume a staged mesh injection.

      Peer comparison is case-insensitive; amount and phase must match exactly. The caller supplies the allowed phases because recovery eligibility depends on the surrounding workflow.

      Parameters:
      op - operation type, normally OPEN
      peer - Lightning peer public key to match without case sensitivity
      amount - exact requested local amount in satoshis
      phases - mesh injection phases safe to resume
      pageable - page size limiting the candidate recovery set
      Returns:
      matching resumable decisions newest first

    • findOrphanedReserves
